Back At You is an automated social media platform built for real estate brokerages. Their SocialBAY product pulls listing data from your MLS and auto-generates branded posts, slideshow videos, and templated content. It works across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok. But the content is template-driven — not custom local graphics designed for your market. Plans start at $75/month plus a $149 activation fee.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
Here is how they compare across every category that matters.
Back At You uses pre-built templates applied to your branding. Every agent on the platform gets the same designs with different logos.
VEXI creates custom local graphics for your market.
Back At You auto-generates listing slideshow videos from MLS photos. No professional short-form video editing. No Reels, no TikToks from your footage.
VEXI edits your videos for you.
Before you see a single post, Back At You charges a one-time $149 setup fee on top of your monthly plan.
Back At You auto-posts content without a review step. You cannot preview, approve, or request revisions before content goes live.
Back At You posts to 5 platforms but skips Google Business Profile, YouTube, and Pinterest.
The Verdict: Back At You vs VEXI

A brokerage-focused automation tool that pulls MLS data and posts templated content across 5 platforms. Good for brokerages who want hands-off listing promotion. But the content is template-driven, there is no professional video editing, no content approval workflow, and a $149 activation fee before you start.
Built for people who want it done right. No activation fees.
Does Back At You include video editing?
No. Back At You auto-generates listing slideshow videos from MLS photos, but does not offer professional short-form video editing.
Does Back At You charge an activation fee?
Yes. Back At You charges a $149 one-time activation fee on top of monthly plan costs.
Which platforms does Back At You post to?
Back At You posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok — five platforms. It does not support Google Business Profile, YouTube, or Pinterest.
